heading: Which one do I need?
lede: Start from what you're building. Each line names the standard to look at first.

items.situation: You offer APIs, MCP servers or agents and want to be found
items.note: Serve the same file at both ard.json and ai-catalog.json.

items.situation: Agents use your site inside people's browsers
items.note: Add tools to your key flows, and keep the normal page.

items.situation: You have lots of structured content people and agents want to query
Your bot visits other sites, or you need to verify bots on yours
You want agents to create accounts on your service without a sign-up form
Customers' own agents should sign in and act on their accounts
items.note: Track it; Draft 0.1 is from October 9, 2026.

items.situation: You sell goods and want any AI assistant to browse, cart and check out
You want your products shown in ChatGPT
An agent pays and you need proof a person approved those exact terms
Agents pay per call or by the minute, with cards or stablecoins
You charge per API request in stablecoins, with no accounts
